name: Mugen no Anastasia
source:
Your life as a student was spent living unchanging days,
until the day of the long awaited school trip came!
On the day of the trip, your bus was suddenly involved in an accident… 
 By the time you came to, everyone aside from you seemed to be unconscious!
You escaped the bus to search for help.
Suddenly the Greek gods appeared while you were searching for help.

[from [url=http://www.ge-nius.com/#!product-information/c1iwz]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你的学生时代一直在重复不变的日子，直到期待已久的修学旅行到来！
旅行当天，巴士突然遭遇事故……
恢复意识时，除了你之外，所有人似乎都失去了知觉！
你逃出巴士，寻找帮助。
寻找途中，希腊诸神突然出现在你面前。

[翻译自[url=http://www.ge-nius.com/#!product-information/c1iwz]官方网站[/url]]
